ModMetaData.name: EatingAnim - Lightweight Pawn Animations
ModMetaData.author: Ketschbopp
ModMetaData.description:
Small, quick, render-only animations that make pawns feel alive:
- Eating: spoon-to-mouth bites at a table, hunched hand-to-mouth eating on the ground, head-down grazing for animals. - Cooking: stirring a bowl while tossing the bill's real ingredients into the mix. - Butchering: cleaver chops with impact. - Manufacturing and crafting: hammering, sewing, chiselling, mixing. - Work: construction, mining, planting, cleaning, research, tending. - Games and reading: moving board-game pieces, dealing cards, throwing games, flipping book pages. - Apparel and equipment: wiggling into (and out of) clothes, a quick flourish when equipping a weapon.
Every animation category can be switched off in the mod settings, along with the hand-held props, and there is a global intensity and speed slider.
Performance: nothing runs on the game tick. All work happens while drawing pawns that are already on screen, is computed from the pawn's current job without any per-pawn state, and allocates no memory per frame. Off-screen pawns cost nothing, so TPS is unaffected.
Requires Harmony.
